title: Verify policy propagation from API descriptions

context.hint: Enforce the configured request policy through every API inspection entry point.
context.surface: An API inspection engine can probe operations directly or through an API description.
assumptions: Use a disposable local HTTP server with synthetic state.

review.invariant: Inspection initiated from an API description enforces the same effective request policy as direct inspection.
review.verification: Run API-description inspection against a local fixture with recorded requests. Check state preservation by default and the explicit opt-in control.

source_observation.summary: The repaired API-description entry preserved fixture state and the opt-in control exercised the enabled operation. The surrounding probe was stubbed because one transport executable was unavailable. Redirect scope enforcement remained a separate unconfirmed observation.
